signatureAbility.signatureDescription: RAC receivers fight for every possible yard after making a catch. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on RAC catches against single coverage.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and inside the numbers
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus deep routes 20+ yards from the LoS.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.
Quarterbacks with generational arms have the power to stretch any defense to its breaking point. When they enter the zone, their maximum throw distance is increased by 15+ yards.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all deep throws while their feet are set (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability receive better pass blocking from their offensive linemen.
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while their feet are set in the pocket
Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes (except on high/low throws).
Defenders with this ability have a greater chance of forcing fumbles when landing Perfect Hit Sticks
